# Terrace Standard

> > Community newspaper serving Terrace and northwestern British Columbia with local news, digital archives, and weekly print editions.

The Terrace Standard is a Black Press Media publication covering local news, events, and community issues in Terrace, BC. The editorial team includes Joe Griffith, Thom Barker, and Rod Link, providing comprehensive coverage of northwestern British Columbia.

## Key Topics

- Terrace Standard
- Black Press Media
- British Columbia news
- Northwestern BC
